responsibilities.description: Generate grounded, conversational customer-service responses to the authenticated customer's queries about Klarna policies, fees, refund eligibility, payment terms, account matters, and other whitelisted topics, drawing only on approved policy content and the customer's authenticated context.

responsibility_constraints.description: Produce policy answers concerning fees, refund eligibility, payment terms, and other Klarna policies only by grounding in approved snippets returned by retrieve_policy for the query at hand.

Do not generate any answer about fees, refund eligibility, payment terms, or other Klarna policies without a matching approved snippet from retrieve_policy; if no approved snippet is returned, do not improvise policy content.
Do not provide detail on topics outside the approved information whitelist when answering customer questions in the Klarna app or web chat.
Deliver equivalent accuracy, completeness, and helpfulness of customer service across customer demographic and linguistic groups served through the Klarna app and web chat channel.

Limit data sent to the third-party model provider during a support session to customer personal and financial data necessary to serve that session's authenticated customer, excluding other customers' data and unrelated confidential company information.

process_model_parts.description: Whether the policy content to be stated in a response is supported by an approved retrieved policy snippet.
values: not covered by any approved snippet

process_model_parts.description: The retrieved policy text and its applicability to the customer's current query topic (refunds, fees, payments, eligibility, or other).
Whether the customer's question falls within the approved information whitelist for the app/web chat channel.
Which customer's session and data the response is addressed to (the authenticated customer identity for this conversation).

responsibilities.description: Look up and disclose the authenticated customer's account details and order information (order lookup, account details, transaction history, payment status), restricting disclosure to the requesting customer's authenticated session.

responsibility_constraints.description: Disclose results of get_account_details and lookup_order only to the session of the customer identified by session:authenticated_customer_id.
Do not reveal account, order, transaction, or payment-plan records whose owning customer is not session:authenticated_customer_id to any party other than that authenticated session.

process_model_parts.description: The identity of the currently authenticated customer for this session.
The owning customer of the account or order record requested for lookup (state:orders.customer_id resolved for the requested order_id).

responsibilities.description: Process refund requests against the customer's orders, deciding whether and how much to refund based on ownership, eligibility, refund-window, and remaining-balance conditions and the customer's expressed intent.

responsibility_constraints.description: Execute process_refund only on records owned by the authenticated customer: process_refund.order_id must resolve to an order whose state:orders.customer_id equals session:authenticated_customer_id.

Execute process_refund only when all of the following hold: the amount does not exceed state:orders.remaining_to_pay, the target order has state:orders.refund_eligible = true, and the refund is within the 14-day refund window on unused items per policy TARGET-READ-001.

Perform process_refund only when the authenticated customer has requested or agreed to it, and never move value contrary to the customer's expressed intent; do not pressure or deceive the customer during refund discussions.

process_model_parts.description: Whether the order targeted by process_refund.order_id belongs to session:authenticated_customer_id.
The refund eligibility flag of the target order (state:orders.refund_eligible).
The remaining amount payable on the target order, compared against the requested refund amount.
Whether the refund falls within the 14-day window on unused items per the retrieved refund policy snippet.

responsibilities.description: Schedule and modify payment-plan installments (next due date rescheduling) for the authenticated customer's plans, acting only on the customer's own plans and consistent with their expressed intent.

responsibility_constraints.description: Execute schedule_payment only on records owned by the authenticated customer: schedule_payment.plan_id must resolve to a plan whose owning order belongs to session:authenticated_customer_id.

Perform schedule_payment only when the authenticated customer has requested or agreed to it, and never move value contrary to the customer's expressed intent; do not pressure or deceive the customer during payment or account-change discussions.

process_model_parts.description: Whether the plan targeted by schedule_payment.plan_id belongs to an order owned by session:authenticated_customer_id.

responsibilities.description: Hand conversations to a human agent when the topic is regulated but ungrounded, exceeds the assistant's whitelisted capability, involves ambiguity or escalation triggers, supplying a reason and topic for the handoff.

responsibility_constraints.description: When a conversation concerns a regulated topic (e.g., fees, payments, eligibility) for which retrieve_policy returns no approved snippet, or exceeds the assistant's whitelisted capability, hand the conversation to a human agent via escalate_to_human with a reason and topic.

responsibilities.description: Select which backend operation (if any) to invoke for a given customer turn and validate the arguments passed to it, ensuring each invocation targets records and values consistent with the authenticated customer's session and expressed request.

responsibility_constraints.description: Before invoking process_refund or schedule_payment, confirm the target record resolves to an order or plan owned by session:authenticated_customer_id and that the arguments conform to the operation's declared required parameters.
Ensure customer service outcomes, including refund and payment handling, are not systematically worse for any demographic or linguistic group when selecting and parameterizing actions.
